headline: Virginia Medicaid coverage changes take effect for specified gender-dysphoria services
content_limits: Attribute implementation to DMAS and the federal rule.
Keep Medicaid under-18 and CHIP under-19 boundaries distinct.
Limit continued federal participation to existing cross-sex hormone-therapy recipients.
Do not claim universal private or state-only coverage exclusion.
Do not claim current legal enforcement or a certified current docket.
